selected_leaf: Derive a verifier-compatible recovery algorithm for a stale role-local checkpoint versus newer target-authoritative evidence, specify precedence when local state lags COMMIT_PROVEN_IN_SCOPE or CONFLICT, and prove reconciliation cannot authorize a second logical effect.

bounded_leaf_result.tested_scope: Abstract recurring-Chat Stage T protocols preserving one immutable logical_effect_id and exact (T,w,d), with a role-local CAS checkpoint and a target-authoritative verifier that can produce COMMIT_PROVEN_IN_SCOPE or CONFLICT for exact (T,w,d). A target observation counts as newer only when the target itself exposes an immutable or monotonic order/freshness witness sufficient to prove it supersedes the checkpoint's last consumed target evidence. No concrete product/API is claimed to supply that witness.
recovery_algorithm: Load the current role-local checkpoint C and freeze logical_effect_id,T,w,d. Never infer a new witness from target state.

Run only the frozen target-authoritative verifier for exact T,w,d and obtain observation V plus its target-authoritative evidence identity/order witness q. If V cannot be bound to exact T,w,d or q cannot establish the required freshness relation, classify UNRESOLVED_UNSAFE and permit no mutation.

If C is nonterminal and fresh V=COMMIT_PROVEN_IN_SCOPE for exact T,w,d, target terminal evidence has precedence: reconcile C to COMMITTED, record q and the verifier evidence locator, and set mutation_permitted=false.

If C is nonterminal and fresh V=CONFLICT for exact T,w,d or for an exact target exclusivity condition that proves this intended effect cannot commit, target terminal evidence has precedence: reconcile C to CONFLICT, record q and the verifier evidence locator, and set mutation_permitted=false.

If C is already COMMITTED or CONFLICT, no nonterminal target observation, absence result, timeout, transport acknowledgement, or older evidence may regress it. A consistent fresh terminal observation may strengthen evidence only; it never re-arms mutation.

If a fresh target terminal observation contradicts an already-terminal local classification, reconcile to UNRESOLVED_UNSAFE with both evidence identities preserved and mutation_permitted=false. Do not choose either side by timestamp alone.

If V is unresolved/nonterminal while C is ATTEMPT_ARMED or VERIFY_PENDING, preserve the crash-conservative local state and attempt_may_have_occurred=true. Do not fall back to VERIFY_BEFORE_ATTEMPT and do not mint a replacement witness.

Persist the reconciled checkpoint only with role-local CAS against the exact predecessor checkpoint blob/revision. A CAS mismatch ends this reconciliation attempt without target mutation; the next recurrence must reload the winner and re-run the verifier rather than spin or reuse a stale local plan.

precedence_rule.highest: fresh target-authoritative COMMIT_PROVEN_IN_SCOPE or CONFLICT bound to exact T,w,d may terminally resolve a nonterminal local checkpoint
precedence_rule.middle: an already-terminal local COMMITTED/CONFLICT classification is monotonic against nonterminal, absent, transport-level, or older target evidence
precedence_rule.contradiction: fresh contradictory terminal evidence versus a local terminal classification yields UNRESOLVED_UNSAFE, never a mutation authorization
precedence_rule.lowest: local timestamps, retry counters, cached success, transport acknowledgements, and unresolved verifier results never override target-authoritative terminal evidence or re-arm a terminal checkpoint

reconciliation_invariants: Identity invariant: logical_effect_id,T,w,d remain byte-for-byte unchanged during reconciliation.
Terminal monotonicity: reconciliation never transitions COMMITTED or CONFLICT back to a mutation-capable protocol state.
Crash conservatism: ATTEMPT_ARMED/VERIFY_PENDING never regress to VERIFY_BEFORE_ATTEMPT merely because the target verifier is unresolved.
Target-terminal dominance over stale local nonterminal state: fresh exact-scope COMMIT_PROVEN_IN_SCOPE or CONFLICT is consumed as terminal evidence before any future mutation decision.
CAS isolation: a stale role-local checkpoint cannot overwrite a newer checkpoint and cannot authorize a target mutation after losing CAS.
no_second_effect_proof_sketch: Reconciliation itself performs no target mutation; its only possible write is the role-local CAS checkpoint.
Every path freezes the same logical_effect_id,T,w,d and explicitly forbids witness rotation, so reconciliation cannot create a new effect identity.

When fresh target-authoritative COMMIT_PROVEN_IN_SCOPE or CONFLICT exists, the algorithm moves a nonterminal local checkpoint to a terminal no-mutation state before any future action. Thus a stale local ATTEMPT_ARMED or VERIFY_PENDING state cannot trigger a second logical effect after the target has already resolved the first.

When target evidence is unresolved or its freshness/order cannot be proven, mutation_permitted remains false for the reconciliation step and crash-conservative local state is preserved. Ambiguity therefore fails closed rather than reopening the effect.
When local and fresh target terminal classifications contradict, the result is UNRESOLVED_UNSAFE with no mutation authorization, so contradiction cannot be converted into a retry.
If the local CAS loses, no target mutation follows from the stale plan. Reload-and-reverify on a later recurrence preserves single-effect safety without same-run spinning.

Therefore, within the tested abstract scope, a stale role-local checkpoint can be advanced by newer target-authoritative terminal evidence but cannot regress terminality, rotate the witness, or authorize a second logical target effect.
unresolved_conditions: A concrete target must expose a target-authoritative immutable or monotonic evidence identity/order witness sufficient to distinguish newer terminal evidence from stale or replayed observations; local wall-clock timestamps are not enough.
A concrete verifier must prove exact binding to T,w,d and distinguish true target CONFLICT from transient absence or transport failure.

The next local proof obligation is to derive the minimal target-evidence freshness/order witness and comparison rule that prevents stale target observations from regressing ATTEMPT_ARMED, VERIFY_PENDING, COMMITTED, or CONFLICT checkpoints.
